Noah (People Ops): Quick heads-up: All-hands Friday 10:00am PT. Two asks: drop a 1-2 line agenda bullet or a question by Thu EOD, and tag anyone you want on the panel. We'll record and post slides + a short transcript.

June (CEO): I'll open with a business update and a short note on hiring priorities.

Aria (Product): I'll demo the Dedicated autopilot and outline the canary timeline. tagging @Dex for infra/RTO notes.

Dex (Eng): I'll cover runtime callouts: new batching defaults, a troubleshooting tip for live Qs, and a short policy note about debug-log retention for Dedicated.

Olive (Security): We'll also announce an internal change to audit-log retention and export controls 1: short blurb for legal/reg teams.

Kai (Platform): I'll drop a slide showing p95 improvements after KV cache plus a note on ongoing quantization experiments.

Noah (People Ops): Draft agenda: 10:00 intro (June), 10:06 Product demo (Aria), 10:18 Eng callouts + policy (Dex), 10:26 Security & audit update (Olive), 10:32 CS highlight + metrics, 10:38 Q&A, 10:50 Close + TL;DR. Please keep bullets short.

Aria (Product): Can infra/plat be on the Q&A panel? @Dex @Kai

Dex (Eng): Yep. Paste-able troubleshooting snippet for the thread if asked about batching:
```
redwoodctl inspect batching --profile=balanced
redwoodctl restart inference-service
```

Olive (Security): Policy notes: debug-log retention default set to 30 days; audit-log retention extended to 365 days for compliance plans; export requires approval for Dedicated customers. I'll put the short policy language in the slides.

June (CEO): TL;DR for those who can't make it: 1) Dedicated autopilot canary + rollout plan; 2) debug-log default retention shorter, Dedicated can request changes via support; 3) audit-log retention update for compliance customers; 4) p95 latency improvements. Recording + slides will be posted after the meeting.

record-bot: Calendar invite posted: https://calendar.example.com/event/5077777777 (Zoom link in invite).

(After meeting) record-bot: Recording + slides are live -> https://videos.example.com/5077777777 and https://drive.example.com/5077777777-slides.pdf

Noah (People Ops): Post-meeting TL;DR: Autopilot canary next week (owners in follow-up doc), debug-log retention default = 30 days (Dedicated can request extensions via support), audit-log retention for compliance customers = 365 days and export controls added, p95 improved ~18% after KV cache. Follow-ups and owners in the shared doc.

Aria (Product): I'll publish the rollout checklist and owners doc later today.

Dex (Eng): RFC for retention & export controls: https://docs.redwood.example.org/rfcs/log-retention-and-export-2026

Olive (Security): If you have regulatory questions, ping me and I'll connect you to the compliance readout.

Noah (People Ops): Thanks all. If you had a question that wasn't answered live, reply here and we'll route it. Meeting closed. :sparkles:
